newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Britain's Prince Charles arrives in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Prince Charles arrives in Bangladesh.

text.p: Britain's Prince Charles arrived in Bangladesh on Wednesday on a three-day visit to see British-aided projects and meet relatives of Bangladeshis living in the United Kingdom.
The Prince of Wales was greeted by Bangladesh Foreign Minister Abdus Samad Azad as he flew in by a private jet from Qatar.
He will meet Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and Mohammad Yunus, head of the revolutionary Grameen Bank which extends credit to rural poor, mostly women.
The Prince will visit a slum in Dhaka and a child daycare centre run by ActionAid, a British non-government organisation.
He will also fly to the northeastern tea-growing district of Sylhet, home to most of the Bangladeshis living in Britain, and open a British Telecom-built earth satellite station there.
